lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Welcome to the tutorial! Let's learn how to move around.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Use the arrow keys to move your character.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Use the left shift key while in air to dash.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Great job! Now jump as far as possible to the right.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: NO TIME TO EXPLAIN! ATTACK. CLICK. CLICK. CLICK. CLICK.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: You did it! Now let's move on to the next section.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Uhh... pretend this is a trap and you have to dash through it to avoid it.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: It will be added for real later...

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Just go through the door and climb to the top of the shrine to finish the tutorial.

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Now... wait for the rest of the game to be made before you can play it!

lines.speaker: Tutorial Guide
lines.text: Just hang around or something.. vee please make the tutorial look nice for the demo..
